articles.title: Camping a popular option for Quebec vacationers
articles.summary: Camping organizations in Quebec, Canada, report a significant surge in campground site bookings, primarily driven by younger individuals, newcomers, and first-time camping enthusiasts. A recent Camping Québec report highlights this growing interest, indicating a strong trend towards outdoor activities and nature-based recreation across the province. This demonstrates a notable shift in leisure preferences among various demographics.

articles.title: Army eyes one-way desi drones with 1,000-km strike envelope
articles.summary: The Indian Army has initiated a process to acquire indigenous long-range, one-way attack drones. The defence industry is invited to offer systems capable of accurately hitting targets up to 1,000 km away. This move aims to significantly enhance the Army's precision strike capabilities and operational reach, aligning with the nation's push for self-reliance in advanced military technology.

articles.title: Show HN: Instrumation a PYPI library for Instruments
articles.summary: A new project introduces a high-level Hardware Abstraction Layer (HAL) designed for RF test stations. This innovation aims to simplify RF test bench automation, enabling engineers to concentrate on developing core test logic rather than grappling with repetitive connection code, such as PyVISA boilerplate. The initiative promises increased efficiency in technical testing environments.
